description: This file is a platform-specific script for OpenWrt firmware upgrade and configuration management for various hardware boards. It contains functions to check images, perform upgrades, and copy configurations depending on the board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image for compatibility based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade specific to the hardware board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the configuration to the hardware board based on the board type.
